decisions.text: Jamie Brennan (Youth) was shown a straight red against Bolton Wanderers and is banned for 1 match. The club secretary rates an appeal at 40 percent. Win and the ban is wiped. Lose and the panel makes it 2 matches. It has to go in before the next match.
decisions.resolved: No appeal went in before the next match, so the 1 match ban stood.

decisions.text: A sponsor wants the squad at a photo shoot on the day off and will pay £200k for the afternoon. The supporters trust has asked for the same afternoon for an open day at the training ground, and the local paper wants to cover it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: A local school has asked for a first team visit, and the community department would like the manager to front it. The board like to see the manager doing this sort of thing.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: Diego Kimura (Youth) was shown a straight red against Derby County and is banned for 2 matches. The club secretary rates an appeal at 40 percent. Win and the ban is wiped. Lose and the panel makes it 3 matches. It has to go in before the next match.
decisions.resolved: No appeal went in before the next match, so the 2 matches ban stood.

decisions.text: The board want you at an investors dinner on Thursday. A paper has asked for a long sit down interview the same evening.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.
